summary: [Twilio Messaging] idempotency: No native idempotency-key on messages.create. Inbound dedupe by MessageSid (unique constraint). Outbound: record the Sid from create; on timeout reconcile by listing before re-POST. Scheduled (not-yet-sent) messages can be cancelled/updated. Verify API is idempotent by design for OTP: prefer over hand-rolled codes.
